companyStory: Renovation Contractor SG was built on one principle: you deserve to deal directly with the people building your home. We are a 100% in-house Singapore renovation team — our master tilers, carpenters, electricians, plumbers, and painters are all on our payroll. No subcontracting. No interior design middlemen. No hidden markups. With deep roots across HDB estates, condominiums, landed houses, and commercial premises, we deliver transparent pricing, rigorous craftsmanship, and on-time project handovers — every single time.

workingProcess.title: On-Site Measurement & Consultation
workingProcess.desc: We visit your property for detailed site measurements, inspect existing masonry/piping conditions, and understand your exact requirements.

workingProcess.title: Itemized Written Quotation
workingProcess.desc: Receive a 100% itemized quotation with clear material specs, scope of works, and zero hidden variation buffers.

workingProcess.title: Permits & Milestone Contract
workingProcess.desc: We sign a formal Singapore renovation contract with milestone payment dates and submit all HDB/BCA renovation permits.

workingProcess.title: Daily Supervised Construction
workingProcess.desc: Our in-house master craftsmen execute hacking, piping, waterproofing, tiling, and carpentry with daily photo updates on WhatsApp.

workingProcess.title: Rigorous Quality & Defect Checks
workingProcess.desc: Mandatory 48-hour waterproofing ponding tests and joint laser-alignment defect checks before cleaning.

workingProcess.title: Handover & Warranty Issuance
workingProcess.desc: Final walkthrough inspection, handover of keys, and issuance of our signed written workmanship warranty.

members.name: Managing Director & Founder
members.bio: Founder & Director of Renovation Contractor SG. Direct on-site supervision, plumbing & sanitary installations, structural works, and quality control from hacking to final handover.
